learningSetup.lectures: Physics Wallah downloads + compressed class-slide notes
learningSetup.notebookAndPractice: JNote + NEETprep question bank and tests
learningSetup.coreRule: Finish the next assigned lesson, then retrieve and practise what it taught you. Do not wait for motivation, do not rewrite every slide, and do not repay a missed day by sacrificing sleep.

tracks.name: Physics Track
tracks.sequenceRule: Class 12 sequence first (109 lectures), then Units & Measurements (11), Thermal Properties (10), KTG & Thermodynamics (10). Oscillations/Waves are in Track 4.

tracks.name: Organic + Inorganic Chemistry Track
tracks.sequenceRule: GOC, Hydrocarbons and remaining Organic chapters, then Chemical Bonding through Salt Analysis; use remaining 37 Chemistry slots (20 Mar - 1 May) for Chemistry MCQs and error-log revision.

tracks.name: Biology Track
tracks.sequenceRule: Biomolecules (Zoology) first, then Class 12 Biology topics, then the 3 remaining Class 11 Botany chapters (Respiration, Photosynthesis, Plant Growth).

tracks.name: Track 4 (Oscillations/Waves + Physical Chemistry)
tracks.completedBreakdown: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry (16 lectures)
tracks.sequenceRule: Oscillations (12) + Waves (11) = 23 lectures first; then 80 remaining Physical Chemistry lectures.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Wake, Water, Wash & Daylight
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Wake, drink water, wash, get 10-20 minutes of daylight near home or outside if safe; zero social media scrolling.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Open Day Checklist
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Choose the exact four video numbers for today and queue the NEETprep question set.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Lecture 1: Physics Track
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Watch assigned Physics lecture (Class 12 sequence first). Keep compressed slide notes only.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Movement & Water Break
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Stand, stretch, drink water; keep the tablet away from feeds.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Lecture 2: Chemistry Track
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Watch assigned Organic/Inorganic lecture (or Chemistry MCQ & error-log revision from 20 Mar).

dailyTimetableIST.title: Meal, Rest & Optional Power Nap
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Eat lunch and rest. Optional 15-20 minute nap; never let it become a long late-afternoon sleep.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Lecture 3: Biology Track
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Watch assigned Biology lecture. Use the teacher's slides as the base; never do a second full rewrite.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Snack & Short Walk
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Take a snack and a short walk or movement break; in Imphal rain or cold, do gentle indoor movement.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Lecture 4: Track 4 (Osc/Waves -> Physical Chem)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Watch Oscillations/Waves first, then the remaining Physical Chemistry queue.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Dinner & Screen Break
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Step away from the screen, eat dinner, rest your eyes.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Self-Study A: Physics (50 min)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: 10m: close notes, write concepts/formulas from memory. 25m: solve 12-20 focused questions. 15m: check wrong/guessed answers and log reason in JNote.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Short Break (10 min)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Stretch, hydrate, rest eyes.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Self-Study B: Chemistry (50 min)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: 10m closed-book recall. 25m practice (mechanisms for Organic, facts/structures for Inorganic). 15m error log.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Short Break (15 min)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Walk around the room, drink water.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Self-Study C: Biology (50 min)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: 20m NCERT/slide close-reading, 20m closed-book recall of terms/diagrams/tables, 10m NEETprep questions.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Short Break (10 min)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Quick stretch and eye rest.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Self-Study D: Track 4 (50 min)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Practice today's Oscillations/Waves or Physical Chemistry numericals. After 1 Mar, use for mixed practice.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Cumulative Active Recall + Error Log + Loops A-F (40 min)
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Run D0/D1/D3/D7/D14/D30 spaced cycle and rotate one old completed chapter loop (Loops A-F) using error-log questions.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Tick Lectures & Queue Tomorrow
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Tick completed videos, set tomorrow's exact 4 videos, write the exact first 10-minute action, put phone outside arm's reach.

dailyTimetableIST.title: Mandatory 8-Hour Sleep Window
dailyTimetableIST.instruction: Sleep 8 hours minimum. Never borrow from sleep to repay a missed lecture.

phases.name: Phase 0: Setup
phases.purpose: Set up downloaded PW videos, JNote folders, NEETprep practice lists and chapter tracker. Establish 02:00-10:00 sleep window.
phases.testRule: No scored baseline needed. Start lessons on 2 Nov.

phases.name: Phase 1: Routine Build
phases.purpose: Four daily lessons; keep notes compact. Start with Class 12 Physics electricity, GOC, Biology Biomolecules, and Physics Oscillations/Waves.
phases.testRule: Short Sunday quizzes from completed material only; two full recovery Sundays.

phases.name: Phase 2: Finish Core Tracks
phases.purpose: Maintain lecture completion. Increase questions as understanding improves. Keep old chapters alive with spaced recall.
phases.testRule: Monthly checkpoint tests; record accuracy and repeat error types. No full mock before enough syllabus is covered.

phases.name: Phase 3: Finish Remaining Lessons
phases.purpose: Biology, Chemistry, and Track 4 counted queues finish in March; their slots become question practice and error-log revision. Finish Physics Class 12 then Units, Thermal and KTG/Thermodynamics.
phases.testRule: Use cumulative tests; from late March, full mocks only if representative of syllabus actually covered.

phases.name: Phase 4: Exam Taper
phases.purpose: No new notes system, no wholesale lecture restart. Review formulas, reactions, NCERT errors and test log. Keep meals/sleep stable.
phases.testRule: Stop full mocks about a week before exam; light recall and logistics. Shift this phase if NTA changes the date.

oldChapterRecallLoops.title: Loop A - Physics Foundations
oldChapterRecallLoops.method: Make a formula map, then solve a small question set.

oldChapterRecallLoops.title: Loop B - Physics Mechanics
chapters: Centre of Mass / System of Particles
Mechanical Properties of Solids (verify if 2 videos covered chapter)
oldChapterRecallLoops.method: Question-led retrieval; fill a Solids gap only if question analysis shows need.

oldChapterRecallLoops.title: Loop C - Botany Foundations
oldChapterRecallLoops.method: Use NCERT recall, comparison tables and labelled diagrams.

oldChapterRecallLoops.title: Loop D - Zoology Foundations
oldChapterRecallLoops.method: Closed-book NCERT recall and question practice.

oldChapterRecallLoops.title: Loop E - Chemistry Foundations
chapters: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry (16 completed lectures)
Completed Organic Foundation Chapter 1 (IUPAC / Structural Identification)
Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
oldChapterRecallLoops.method: Solve questions and recall definitions/trends before reviewing notes.

oldChapterRecallLoops.title: Loop F - Mixed Audit
chapters: 30-40 Question Mixed Set across Loops A-E
oldChapterRecallLoops.method: Sort weak topics from the mixed set, log errors, then cycle back to Loop A.

weekdayFocusByDay.MONDAY: Core examples; note 2 unclear points. 50m/track + 40m recall.
weekdayFocusByDay.TUESDAY: Solve first; check and log errors. 50m/track + 40m recall.
weekdayFocusByDay.THURSDAY: NEETprep / PYQs; analyse wrong options. 50m/track + 40m recall.
weekdayFocusByDay.SATURDAY: Update error log; tick completed videos. 50m/track + 40m recall.

PHYSICS.chapter: Physics Review (30 weak-unit MCQs; log errors)

sundayGuide.title: Set-up day
sundayGuide.instructions: Set up PW downloads, JNote folders, NEETprep lists and video tick sheet. 60-90 minutes, then relax.

sundayGuide.title: Light weekly check
sundayGuide.instructions: 45-60 min recall + 30-40 questions from covered topics. Correct mistakes; cap total at 2 hours.

sundayGuide.title: Full rest
sundayGuide.instructions: No test or backlog work. Meals, movement, hobby time and normal sleep.

sundayGuide.title: Sectional test
sundayGuide.instructions: 60-90 min covered-topic test + 45-60 min error review, then rest.

sundayGuide.title: Old-chapter recall
sundayGuide.instructions: 60 min rotate old Physics, Biology and Chemistry topics; plan next week for 15 min.

sundayGuide.title: Mini test
sundayGuide.instructions: 90 min mixed test from covered topics + up to 45 min analysis.

sundayGuide.title: Recovery Sunday
sundayGuide.instructions: Optional 30-45 min Biology NCERT recall; otherwise take the day off.

sundayGuide.title: Sectional test
sundayGuide.instructions: 90 min topic test + 45-60 min error analysis.

sundayGuide.title: Full rest
sundayGuide.instructions: No lectures or formal test. No guilt-based backlog.

sundayGuide.title: Monthly checkpoint
sundayGuide.instructions: 90-120 min mixed test from covered chapters; choose only 3 January priorities.

sundayGuide.title: Subject mini test
sundayGuide.instructions: 90 min test on covered topics + up to 45 min error review.

sundayGuide.title: Full rest
sundayGuide.instructions: No test. Daylight, movement and the regular 8-hour sleep window.

sundayGuide.title: Sectional test
sundayGuide.instructions: 90-120 min from covered topics; write the three most valuable corrections.

sundayGuide.title: Month-end checkpoint
sundayGuide.instructions: Up to 2h mixed test + 45 min review; compare recurring errors, not just score.

sundayGuide.title: Subject test
sundayGuide.instructions: 90-120 min; focus on applying concepts, then review errors.

sundayGuide.title: Full rest
sundayGuide.instructions: No study required. Recovery does not have to be earned.

sundayGuide.title: Mixed topic test
sundayGuide.instructions: 2h mixed test + up to 45 min review. Shorten if tired; do not cut sleep.

sundayGuide.title: Light recall
sundayGuide.instructions: 45-60 min formulas, reaction maps and Biology diagrams; rest afterward.

sundayGuide.title: Subject test
sundayGuide.instructions: 90-120 min test from completed topics + focused error review.

sundayGuide.title: Full rest
sundayGuide.instructions: Step away from the tablet, get outside if practical, and sleep normally.

sundayGuide.title: Mock / coverage test
sundayGuide.instructions: Full mock only if representative; otherwise a 2h cumulative test. Review for 45-60 min.

sundayGuide.title: Backlog triage
sundayGuide.instructions: Up to 2h on the three biggest weak spots in recent tests. No fresh-note overhaul.

sundayGuide.title: Full mock
sundayGuide.instructions: Use latest official format if coverage supports it; review mistakes for up to 60 min.

sundayGuide.title: Full mock
sundayGuide.instructions: Full mock only if representative of what you have studied; otherwise cumulative test.

sundayGuide.title: Last planned full mock
sundayGuide.instructions: One full mock if useful, plus up to 45 min error review. Do not restart lectures.

sundayGuide.title: Taper / recovery
sundayGuide.instructions: 60-90 min max: formulas, marked NCERT lines, error log and exam logistics. No full mock.

sundayGuide.title: NEET 2027 - Provisional Target Date
sundayGuide.instructions: Not officially confirmed. Follow NTA/admit-card instructions; move the final taper if the announced date differs.
